_comment: Copy to db_sources.json and adapt to your schema. Each source runs its query when any keyword appears in the user's message. Use a read-only DB user. These queries match examples/schema.sql.

sources.name: app_errors
sources.label: application errors
sources.query: SELECT id, application, action, code, description, created_at FROM app.error_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

sources.name: job_runs
sources.label: background job runs
sources.query: SELECT id, job_name, status, error_message, duration_ms, created_at FROM app.job_runs WHERE status <> 'completed' OR error_message IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
sources.query_if_empty: SELECT id, job_name, status, duration_ms, created_at FROM app.job_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5

sources.name: audit_logs
sources.label: activity audit logs
sources.query: SELECT id, subject, type, description, created_at FROM app.audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
